result:
Done. The implementation is complete and verified on synthetic data; the sample-construction stage was debugged on the real data without fitting any model.

**Files written**

- `analysis.R`: one parameterised script. Run with `Rscript analysis.R` to execute the 2 origins, 110 one-at-a-time deviations (including duplicates recorded as such), the 4 algebraic checks, and the influence diagnostics, writing every manifest section 6 output under `out/`.
- `tests/run_tests.R` and `tests/test_output.txt`: 70 synthetic-data tests, all passing. They cover WLS estimates, SEs, SSE, condition index, HC1 and cluster covariances and nested F tests against direct matrix algebra and `lm`; strategic deviation on a hand-made market; lag construction across gaps, entries and out-of-market years; the hash format; weight rescaling invariance; and a smoke test of the whole estimation layer (fixed effects, AR(1), centred basis, max-rstudent rule, influence loop, failure handling).
- `README.md`: script structure, item-by-item implementation notes, assumptions, and test summary.

**Verification on real data (construction only).** Every specification's sample builds without error. The O_A sample has 1260 bank-years from 195 banks and O_B has 1255 from 195. Construction logs record counts per step and year, duplicate handling, zero-SD categories, and substitutions.

**Unimplemented items.** None are marked unavailable. Three levels are implementable but degenerate on this data, which the README documents: no savings bank sits in the market counties, so the add-savings level reproduces the origin sample; no same-certificate re-charter exists, so the continuity level equals as-reported; and the components level for other loans keeps only about 206 rows because short-form filers do not report the component items.

**Assumptions to be aware of.** RSSD9425 special-purpose codes are taken as all non-zero values since the dictionary gives no code table. Exactly one available quarter of item 3368 under the min-two rule yields missing average assets. The loan-components level maps the two "other loans" concepts to item 1563 and adds acceptances when commercial loans exclude them. FDIC county membership is resolved from the county name plus state because the financials file carries names rather than codes.
